items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: He was a trombone player with me.

ctx.x: You mentioned that Willie Mays, now that you look back at when it was there at the time, and I began to wonder. Were you in contact with any of the musicians that you were going to play with later or that you were going to meet later? Did you grow up with any of them? Or, were any of them in school with you?
Yeah. Bob, the late Bob Range. He was at Tuggle with me. He was a trombone player with me. And Edward Sims Sales. He was a trombone player with me.
Dud Bascomb. He went to Industrial High. He stayed about 2 blocks from me in Birmingham. He used to have to pass my house on his way with his horn in his hand, going to Industrial High.
